settings.label: Auto-switch
settings.description: Switch accounts automatically before a limit (tycswap auto on|off)
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: 5-hour threshold
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Weekly threshold
settings.description: Switch at this weekly usage percentage
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Model threshold
settings.description: Switch at this usage percentage of every model window session following counts
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Codex auto-switch
settings.description: Also auto-switch Codex accounts wherever auto-switch runs (tycswap auto, auto --once, the dashboard)
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Codex threshold
settings.description: Switch Codex accounts at this usage percentage; 0 = same as the weekly threshold
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Switch cooldown
settings.description: Minimum seconds between proactive switches; after a switch by hand, no switch at all for this long
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Minimum improvement
settings.description: Minimum extra quota required in the next account (%)
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Account order
settings.description: How auto-switch orders qualifying targets (best: most headroom; soonest-reset: earliest weekly renewal)
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.

settings.label: Failed polls
settings.description: Consecutive failed polls before an account is unhealthy
settings.applies: Applies at the next scheduled check.
